description: Revision history for a South Korean statute: every promulgation with its own date, promulgation number, and entry-into-force date, each as a separate historical mst you can pass to kr_law_article. Requires the caller's OC to have the 법령연혁 (law history) service separately enabled under My Applications at open.law.go.kr — if it is not, this throws a specific, actionable upstream error rather than a generic failure. BYOK: pass your OC as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own OC (Open API user id) from https://open.law.go.kr/LSO/main.do, with 법령연혁 enabled under My Applications.

mst.description: Law version id (법령일련번호) from kr_law_search's "mst" field.

name: kr_law_history
title: Kr Law History
